changelog.zh:
- 修复：带签名/一次性 token 的源（CCTV5体育这类 sign=&auth_token= 地址）切外部播放器卡住——预检会占掉源端唯一连接，现在这类地址跳过预检
- 优化：外挂占位页显示代理最近 4 条请求记录，可直接看到卡在哪一步
- 保留：1.5.33 的上游 8s 响应头超时、20s 无数据看门狗、带扩展名的入口 URL
changelog.en:
- Fix: external player hung on signed/one-shot token sources (CCTV5-style `sign=` / `auth_token=` URLs) — the pre-flight probe consumed the single allowed connection; signed URLs now skip it
- Improvement: the external playback placeholder shows the last 4 proxy request records so the failure step is visible
- Kept: 8s upstream header timeout, 20s no-data watchdog and extension-suffixed entry URLs from 1.5.33
